# Update regarding manifesto booklets

**Published: 16th June 2022**

Jersey Post will be delivering a new set of election booklets to the residents of St. Lawrence, St. John and Trinity on Thursday 16 and Friday 17 June. The original booklet contained an error, for which a correction flyer was issued. It has now transpired that Jersey Post consequently failed to deliver the election booklets to an unknown number of residents.

The Jersey Electoral Authority (JEA) has recently learnt that a number of Islanders have received the wrong booklet or no booklet at all. If this applies to you, please email [contact@vote.je](mailto:contact@vote.je) or call 01534 441020 and we will ask Jersey Post to address these issues immediately.

If you are unsure which constituency you are eligible to vote in, please visit the [Constituency Finder](https://www.vote.je/election-22/district-finder/).
